description: Na₄CO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.29 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.50 Å. C is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.57 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom.
